title: 第15章 有意卖给云昊武功拳谱第16章 馆主夫人柴锦玉的阴狠心肠
slug: 聚灵飞升第1126章暗流之下
content_zh:
“哼。”
云昊冷哼抬脚，猛然一脚踩在了云河另一条腿上。
“咔嚓……啊……”
这下两条腿，都被云昊硬生生踩断了。
云河疼死了过去。
要不是看镇上人来人往，加上这些人也不是当初碰到打劫对他杀人越货的流民，云昊可能会真动杀机。
好在这些武夫，从一开始倒不是要杀自己。
解决掉了这些人后，云昊看着地上躺着的几人道：“别再惹我，否则下次我杀了你们。”
说完，捡起地上的烧鸡，头也不回离开了。
他知道有些人是真晕死了过去，有几个是装晕，自己的话他们听得见。
云昊离开后，远处品味酒楼的店小二将发生的一切都看在眼里，也匆匆回酒楼，找金满堂汇报去了。
“你说什么？那小子不仅没事，还一个人打倒了流云武馆的那些武夫？”
听完店小二的讲述，金满堂都不可置信。
他只是对云昊印象不错，想着云昊从他们酒楼走出去，定然会被流云武馆的人打一顿，到时候就让小二送云昊去医馆。
没想到店小二回来讲述了全过程，着实让金满堂惊讶不已。
小二肯定的语气道：“掌柜的我亲眼所见，那个云昊一开始就摔晕了一个，后来四个三流武夫一起上，还是被他一个人干翻打残。
后来是张磊那个二流武夫亲自出手，也仅仅是打了云昊两拳，甚至使用了流云武馆的流云拳法，但终究被云昊重创昏死过去。”
金满堂问道：“依你看，那小子不懂武？”
小二认真道：“掌柜你还不信我吗？我可是咱们金家内武堂出来的人，虽然现在仅仅是二流武者，但眼睛还是有点的，绝对不会看错。
那个叫云昊的小子，完全不懂武，甚至基本的把式都不会，就是一身的蛮力，应该是天生神力的那种人。”

金满堂点了点头，对小二的话自然是信的，只是太过惊讶云昊而已。
他们品味酒楼明面上是酒楼，但暗中真正的业务却是情报收集贩卖等等。
每一个店小二都是家族“内武堂”
从小培养出来的人。
论眼力，比星河小镇那些武夫高得多。
“如此说来，云昊一身神力，不懂武学。”
金满堂又问了一遍。
小二点头：“对，那小子要是懂点武学拳脚，凭着一身可怕的蛮力，别说二流武夫，就是一流武夫，我觉得也能碾压。”
金满堂沉吟了片刻后道：“有点意思，能在这等小地方发现一个天生神力的苗子，倒也不容易，你再去一趟，告诉云昊，就说我们酒楼能给他武功拳谱，他要是感兴趣，让他来找我。”
小二诧异道：“掌柜，你不会是要将咱们金家拳谱卖给那小子吧？这可不行啊，要是让家族长老知道，你会有大麻烦的，再说了，一个山村穷小子他也买不起吧？”
金满堂眯起眼笑道：“你小子懂个屁，金家武学自然不能卖，但大虞王朝市面上流传的《龙象拳谱》却可以。
仅仅需要十两银子而已，那小子应该买得起。”
小二好奇道：“市面上流传的龙象拳谱，没有心法，仅仅有招式，也就能练练外功，没啥用吧？”
“非也，对一般人没用，但龙象拳谱可是大虞王朝开国太祖所创，自有独到之处，没有心法修炼，普通武夫练招式的确用处不大。
content_en:
"Hmph."
Yun Hao snorted coldly, raised his foot, and suddenly stepped on Yun He's other leg.
"Click...ah..."
This time, both legs were trampled off by Yun Hao.
Yunhe was so painful that he passed away.
If he hadn't seen the people coming and going in the town, and if these people weren't the same refugees who had robbed, killed, and stolen goods from him, Yun Hao might have actually committed murder.
Fortunately, these warriors did not intend to kill themselves from the beginning.
After getting rid of these people, Yun Hao looked at the people lying on the ground and said: "Don't mess with me again, or I will kill you next time."
After saying that, he picked up the roast chicken on the ground and left without looking back.
He knew that some people really fainted and some were just pretending to be faint. They could hear what he said.
After Yun Hao left, the waiter from the restaurant in the distance saw everything that happened and hurried back to the restaurant to report to Jin Mantang.
"What did you say? Not only was that kid fine, but he also defeated the martial artists from Liuyun Martial Arts Hall by himself?"
After listening to the waiter's story, Jin Mantang couldn't believe it.
He just had a good impression of Yun Hao, thinking that if Yun Hao walked out of their restaurant, he would definitely be beaten up by the people from Liuyun Martial Arts Hall, so he asked the waiter to take Yun Hao to the hospital.
Unexpectedly, the waiter came back and told the whole process, which really surprised Jin Mantang.
The waiter said in an affirmative tone: "I saw with my own eyes, the shopkeeper, that Yun Hao knocked one of them unconscious at the beginning, and then four third-rate martial artists came together, but they were overturned and maimed by him alone.
Later, Zhang Lei, a second-rate martial artist, personally took action and only punched Yun Hao twice. He even used the Liuyun Boxing Technique of Liuyun Martial Arts School, but in the end he was severely injured by Yunhao and passed out. "
Jin Mantang asked: "In your opinion, that boy doesn't know martial arts?"
The waiter said seriously: "Shopkeeper, don't you still believe me? I am a member of the Jin family's martial arts hall. Although I am only a second-rate martial artist now, I still have good eyesight and I will never be mistaken.
The boy named Yun Hao didn't know anything about martial arts, and he didn't even know the basic moves. He was just full of brute strength, and he should be the kind of person who was born with divine power. "
Jin Mantang nodded, naturally believing what the waiter said, but he was just too surprised by Yun Hao.
They taste the restaurant on the surface as a restaurant, but secretly its real business is intelligence collection and sales, etc.
Every waiter is the family's "inner martial arts hall"
People who have been trained since childhood.
In terms of eyesight, he is much better than those warriors in Galaxy Town.
"So, Yun Hao has divine power and doesn't understand martial arts."
Jin Mantang asked again.
The waiter nodded: "Yes, if that kid knows some martial arts and has terrifying brute strength, I think he can crush even a first-rate martial artist, let alone a second-rate martial artist."
Jin Mantang pondered for a moment and then said: "It's interesting. It's not easy to find a seedling with natural supernatural power in such a small place. You go there again and tell Yun Hao that our restaurant can give him martial arts records. If he is interested, let him come to me."
The waiter was surprised and said: "Shopkeeper, you are not going to sell our Jin family boxing book to that boy, are you? This is not okay. If the family elders find out, you will be in big trouble. Besides, a poor boy from a mountain village can't afford it, right?"
Jin Mantang narrowed his eyes and said with a smile: "You know nothing, the Jin family's martial arts cannot be sold, but the "Dragon Elephant Boxing Manual" circulated on the market during the Dayu Dynasty can.
It only costs ten taels of silver, and that kid should be able to afford it. "
The waiter asked curiously: "The Longxiang Boxing manual circulating on the market has no mental skills. It only has moves and can be used to practice external skills. It's useless, right?"
"No, it is useless to ordinary people, but the Dragon Elephant Boxing Manual was created by the founder of the Dayu Dynasty. It has its own unique features. Without the cultivation of mental methods, it is indeed of little use for ordinary martial artists to practice the moves.
